script_text: The stars are about to crack your world open, Aquarius — Wednesday changes everything. Pluto conjunct your natal Sun in your 1st House gives you an undeniable intensity completely reshaping how others see you. Monday's Moon square Saturn in your 9th House kills communication and travel — stay patient. Wednesday brings Jupiter trines Neptune in your 5th House, igniting bold creativity and a magnetic romance as Venus enters your 7th House of partnerships. The Sun through your 8th House until Friday transforms how you handle shared finances and negotiations. Thursday's Moon blesses your 10th House, making it ideal for career advancement. Wednesday is your best day because that Jupiter-Neptune trine unlocks love and fearless self-expression. Monday is your worst day as Saturn dampens every effort. As an Air sign, your ruling planet Uranus drives this transformation — take one bold career step Thursday. Follow for daily updates.
